ARMY5E.Stand.FiguresStandingHint: Flavour only. A stand fights at full effect until it becomes a casualty.
ARMY5E.Stand.OriginHint: A stand is a copy, not a link. Editing the original creature will not change this stand.
ARMY5E.Stand.CasualtyNotice: This stand is a casualty. It keeps acting until the end of the round, then is eliminated.
ARMY5E.Stand.ScalingHint: As written, a stand of ten creatures has one creature's hit points and damage. Adjust these if your table scales stands up.
ARMY5E.Stand.ScalingModified: This stand deviates from the rules as written.
ARMY5E.Stand.SolosHint: Solos joined to this stand move with it and are targeted as part of it, but use their own AC and saving throws.
ARMY5E.Stand.NoSolos: No solos have joined this stand.
ARMY5E.Stand.Warning.InvalidSize: {name} cannot form a stand. Only creatures of Huge size or smaller can; Gargantuan creatures always fight as solos.
ARMY5E.Stand.Warning.SizeOnSheet: This stand's creature size is not legal. Only Huge or smaller creatures can form stands.
ARMY5E.Unit.TypeHint: Fixed before the battle. Skirmishers roll initiative on their best Dexterity, regiments on their worst.
ARMY5E.Unit.ConfigurationHint: Aid grants adjacent allies advantage at half speed. Defend gives +2 AC but forbids attacking, at half speed. March moves at full speed.
ARMY5E.Unit.StartingStandsHint: Morale is checked once a unit has lost more than half the stands it started with.
ARMY5E.Unit.BrokenNotice: This unit is broken. It may take only the Retreat action until it rallies.
ARMY5E.Unit.CommanderHint: A solo joined to one of this unit's stands. One per unit.
ARMY5E.Unit.Warning.StandsOnly: Only stands and NPCs can be added to a unit. Characters join a stand as solos instead.
ARMY5E.Warning.IncompatibleSystem: Army Combat 5e expects internals that dnd5e {version} does not provide ({methods}). Stands will not prepare correctly. Check for a module update.
